_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Dante Gabriel Rossetti (1828-1882). The Early Italian Poets (1861; later 'Dante and his Circle', 1874), which includes his Vita Nuova; and the Vita Nuova as Gutenberg's clean text. PD. Added 2026-10-02 by lane C under the coordinator's standing instruction (choose further translator shelves); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst.

rossetti-early-italian-poets-1861: The Early Italian Poets from Ciullo d'Alcamo to Dante Alighieri (1861)

rossetti-vita-nuova.note: Also printed inside rossetti-early-italian-poets (Part II): two witnesses, one uid per passage.

rossetti-early-italian-poets.of: Ciullo d'Alcamo, Guido Guinizelli, Guido Cavalcanti, Cino da Pistoia, Dante and others
rossetti-early-italian-poets.work: The Early Italian Poets (Part I: poets before Dante; Part II: Dante and his circle, incl. the Vita Nuova)
rossetti-early-italian-poets.scan_edition: Smith, Elder 1861, first edition (Toronto copy), raw OCR

_pending.rossetti-dante-and-his-circle-1874: The 1874 rearranged edition (Ellis & White): a second witness of the same translations; not fetched.

_excluded.original-poems: Rossetti's own poems (House of Life etc.): not translations.

_name_words_note: Translator name(s) only: fetch_shelf.py treats these as the identity check (one must appear in the fetched text), so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
